body.subject: Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton
body.description: This is a mounted Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton. It stands mid-stride on two thick back legs, its huge skull lowered and its long tail held straight out behind for balance. The bones are dark brown and ridged, on a low platform in a wide hall.
body.size_comparison: It is about as long as a school bus, and its hips are higher than a doorway.
body.fun_fact: Its teeth were about the size of bananas.

body.subject: Giraffe
body.description: This is a giraffe in a grassy enclosure, reaching up to eat leaves from a tall tree. Its neck rises steeply above a sloping back. Its coat is a patchwork of brown shapes on cream, like cracked dry earth.
body.size_comparison: It is taller than a basketball hoop.
body.fun_fact: A giraffe's tongue is dark purple and about as long as your forearm.

body.subject: Triceratops skull, possibly a cast
body.description: This looks like a Triceratops skull on a low plinth. It has a wide bony frill at the back like a fan, and three horns: two long ones above the eyes and a short one on the nose. The surface is rough and grey.
body.size_comparison: It is about as long as a sofa.
body.fun_fact: Triceratops lived at the same time and place as Tyrannosaurus rex.
body.caveats: I'm not certain, but this looks like a Triceratops skull.

body.subject: Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton
body.description: It is about twelve metres long, roughly the length of a school bus, and about four metres tall at the hips, so its back would brush a basketball hoop. A living one weighed about as much as an elephant.
body.size_comparison: It is about as long as a school bus.
